🥩 Review of Hanam Daeji House - Hongik University Entrance Branch
Korean barbecue you must experience in Seoul! 🇰🇷

If you are looking for authentic Korean high-quality barbecue near the bustling Hongdae, Hanam Daejijip is the answer. We offer a premium dining experience that is different from typical barbecue restaurants.

✨ Reasons to visit
Exceptional meat quality: We specialize in the highest quality pork belly, pork neck, and galmaegisal. You'll get thick, fresh, perfectly seasoned meat.

Unique pre-cooking: All meats are first grilled over high-temperature charcoal in a separate kitchen before being served to guests' tables. Through this process, the juice is maintained and a subtle smoky flavor is added, making it more delicious and reducing waiting time.

Stress-Free Table Grill Service: The best part is that our friendly staff will grill and cut your meat right at your table! Sit back and enjoy perfectly grilled meat without worrying about overcooking it or cutting it yourself.

Convenient location: It is a short walk from Hongik University Station (Exit 9), making it very convenient to visit after shopping and sightseeing.

⭐ Tips for tourists
How to eat: Eat the grilled meat wrapped in lettuce with garlic, ssamjang, and grilled kimchi. It's the traditional Korean way!

Waiting times: Can be very busy, especially during peak evening hours (6-8pm). To reduce waiting time, we recommend arriving a little earlier (around 5:30 PM) or later (after 8 PM).
English Menu: English menus are generally available and the staff is familiar with serving foreign guests.

reviews.text: The extra-large japonica eel was really big and thick. The food is first grilled over charcoal and then grilled so all you have to do is eat it comfortably. It was crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, with the perfect eel flavor, so it was very delicious. When I ate it with ginger sauce, it didn't feel greasy and kept going. It was perfect to finish with young radish kimchi noodles as dessert. It's a place where the quality of eel is good, so I think I'll come again next time I crave eel.

reviews.author: Toykim
reviews.text:
This is my favorite skewer restaurant where the food is overall clean, not salty, and delicious. Recommended to go with a close friend.
Tomato nabe is a must, and clam butter and sake steaming is also recommended.
Handmade skewers are basically the best
Highball in black.
The ginkgo skewers are also nice to eat while enjoying the atmosphere.
If you come to Hongdae, be sure to stop by!
Parking is right next door and all-day parking on weekends is 15,000 won in advance, which is great. I also visited Hongdae.
Have a meal too!

reviews.author: Rock Comics Room (AmidangSo)
reviews.text:
Handmade skewers, handmade dumplings, etc. were all made by hand. I happened to visit with a friend on a rainy day, and it was warm, the terrace outside the window was nice, and we had a delicious New Year's Eve.

handmade skebrew, handmade dumplings.
Includes nice warm and quiet atmosphere, affordable prices, and spacious outdoor terrace seats.
I met my friends here. I was happy a lot.

reviews.author: JB K
reviews.text: Since it is a skewer restaurant, it was very delicious and a great snack.

reviews.author: myde
reviews.text: It was clean and nice. I think I'll visit often since it's in front of my office.

reviews.author: 5h4ngho
reviews.text: Skewers are salt

reviews.author: Iphi Lee
reviews.text: It's an old izakaya. I was surprised that it was still there, but when I asked, they said it had been 16 years. It's great for lunch or a drink in the evening.

reviews.author: Strawberry shaved ice
reviews.text: I went there when the owner, who was quiet and unsociable, was in charge of cooking and serving food alone. As for the food, the konjac and edamame (boiled beans) served as side dishes were delicious, and everything I ordered as a side dish was delicious. Perhaps because it is a store frequented by young people, the portions were quite generous. The curry rice I ordered as a meal replacement was spicy and spicy. I liked the crispy eggs. (There was no kimchi, but they provided radish radish so it was even more delicious when eaten with the curry.) The oyster nabe, which was not on the basic menu as it was a seasonal menu, was a great combination of oysters and tofu in a warm soup. The octopus first meal I had when I went before was delicious, but it was cold so I had oyster nabe, grilled shishamo, curry rice, and beer yesterday. Grilled shashimo is so savory that it calls for beer!! We had a great time eating and drinking beer. It seems appropriate to say that it is a restaurant hidden in a quiet place.

reviews.author: Yoo Hwan-seok
reviews.text:
Hidden steamed restaurant~!!! I highly recommend it
I went for dinner and they also made curry for lunch. Shishamo and tuna tataki were the best with soju. It was a shame that I couldn't stay longer because it was limited to 9 o'clock.

reviews.author: MA W
reviews.text:
I like izakaya atmosphere and food so I go there often, but the food here is definitely the best!!! This is the first time that 5 women neatly cleaned out 6 snacks without having a drink~ haha Even the owner seemed surprised... I ate a lot and they didn't give me anything as service, but it was so delicious that I really wanted to write a review~ I was so hungry that I couldn't take a picture at first... but it wasn't until I got a bit full... haha They also serve lunch from 12pm to 2pm, so take the kids out. I have to go eat Jjamppong and curry~ Nagasaki Jjambbong is also greasy so I don't like it that much, but the Jjamppong at this restaurant has a rich soup, but it's not greasy at all.
Even the pickled radish was so delicious.
Haha, I think I'll hear it often from now on.
I really recommend it!!

reviews.author: Seonhee Lee
reviews.text:
A quiet place where you can feel the Japanese atmosphere in Seoul
It was nice to be able to have a fun gathering with friends. It was clean and the taste was satisfying. May the owner prosper~~^^
About a 5-minute walk from Hapjeong Station haha.

reviews.author: Dewani Cage
reviews.text:
Tenderloin cutlet (17,000 won). The meat is very soft and the batter is of just the right thickness without being overly thick. Actually, I liked the cabbage salad better than the tonkatsu. Waited about 20 minutes for lunch on a weekday.

There are all counter seats and they are close together, so it is not a leisurely dining atmosphere. The staff are friendly.

reviews.author: Kim Dong-yoon
reviews.text:
Actually, it's a business I visit a lot, but I haven't written a review before, but now I'm writing one. My favorite restaurant among premium tonkatsu restaurants in Seoul.

I think this place tastes better than Crazy Katsu or Strongest Tonkatsu. If you come to Hapjeong, go here.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
It's a restaurant where you have to wait to eat.
I tried a weekday evening. As expected, there was a wait, but I was still able to get in in 10 minutes.
The pork cutlet is cooked to just the right level on the outside and inside, and although it has plenty of lean meat, it is cooked very deliciously without being dry. The curry is also delicious.
Even if you go to Japan and look around, you won't find many places like this.
A really delicious pork cutlet restaurant.

reviews.author: Professor Pig
reviews.text:
Hapjeong Waiting Restaurant Kawakatsu Hapjeong Branch!!
The quality of Assorted Katsu and Yuringi Katsu is amazing!!
Perhaps because it is well-aged meat, the tenderness is extraordinary.
It was great because both sides were very filling.
The staff were also very friendly.

reviews.author: Lee Dong-hyun (connector)
reviews.text: I thought there would be no chicken cutlet on par with Imakatsu in Korea, but here it was.

address: Basement 1, Jaeryun Building, 25 Jandari-ro 6-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Korea

reviews.author: Vismood Velvet (Visbimmer0120)
reviews.text: The price is reasonable. It's like the old price. For some time now, I have been missing the buckwheat noodles at Jangteo Guksu, but as I was passing by, I was craving buckwheat noodles, so I decided to visit. Wasabi is raw wasabi. The taste is okay. Like other reviews, if it's located nearby, I'd like to use it as a base camp or base for lunch. To truly enjoy this place, it would be nice to enjoy a variety of sides as well. Alcohol is also available, so it feels like an izakaya.

reviews.author: Matboard Chart
reviews.text:
I couldn't pass by when I saw the store's exterior and menu. It has a charm that strangely attracts people. First of all, the price is very reasonable. Basic udon noodles range from 5,000 won to 9,000 won.
So I didn't expect much about the quality, but oh, it's better than I expected. The curry udon, kimchi udon, and rice bowl were all flawless. However, the karaage was a bit tough because it was fried too much, but overall it was good. suggestion!!!

reviews.author: manul garlic
reviews.text: Manpyeong Udon is a udon specialty restaurant with its main branch in Yeongdeungpo. This is a udon restaurant with counter seating, where you can taste good udon and Japanese dishes at reasonable prices. Ordering can be done through a kiosk, and the table circulation is fast, so there is no long waiting period.

reviews.author: View
reviews.text: It’s like the Japanese version of kimbap heaven! It's good value for money and has a lot of menus, but it's a bit disappointing that the operation isn't fast.

reviews.author: Taewook Jang 20 208
reviews.text:
The owner is kind and promptly accepts requests for charging smartphones.
Since this is a great udon restaurant, I also ordered yaki udon.

reviews.author: Jang Eun-cheol
reviews.text: As soon as you enter the store, the smell of curry stimulates your appetite. The menu is varied and the prices are good. Rice and curry are refilled.  It's very tasty and I want to eat it again. The amount of steak is excellent for the price.

reviews.author: hyelyeong Won
reviews.text:
A mindset of respect even if only one person comes
It's delicious, but special marketing offers unlimited refills of curry and rice.
Nevertheless, the bean curry (vegan) is 10,000 won, sorry for the price~
If I could add one more happiness to the happiness of 10,000 won,
If you make a reservation in advance, you will receive a 5,000 won “Plain Nan” the size of your face for free (if word gets out about this, I may be the only one at a loss, so I don't want it to disappear~~~)

Service? My appetite hurts just talking about it.
We talked about respecting customers earlier, right?
He comes every now and then and takes care of it, saying, “Isn’t it enough?” and “Tell me if it’s not enough.”

Mood?  What can I say, my idea is sparkling brightly
It's not like Google is giving me any money.
I'm so impressed that I'm reviewing something I bought with my own money.

I come to this restaurant often, but I don't think I've ever been able to say thank you.

I highly recommend it to foreigners as it is the pride of our country.

You will receive proud Korean service.

reviews.author: Tosil
reviews.text:
❄️Date of visit: February 26
❄️ Number of visitors: 2 people

I happened to go in and have it for lunch while walking down the street, and it was really delicious👍 It went really well with the curry, meat, and chicken, and the finish was slightly spicy, so it wasn't too greasy.
The staff were really friendly and I had a pleasant time.

I'm so happy that I found this restaurant by chance and I definitely want to visit again.

reviews.author: Iphi Lee
reviews.text: The nationality is ambiguous (it could be Indian curry or Japanese curry...), but I still ate it without any problems. I'm most curious about the signature octopus confit curry. (The naan was neither kneaded nor cooked well. It left no mark on me...)

reviews.author: DioBrand
reviews.text:
25.03.15 First visit

Ordered beefsteak curry.
It is a fusion-style Indian curry restaurant, and the curry and rice are said to be refillable. If you are an adult male, refilling is recommended. I felt that the basic serving size was a bit lacking.
The price is a bit disappointing compared to the average taste.
There are single tables by the window and multi-person tables.

address: 1st floor, 15 Yanghwa-ro 10-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: witch
reviews.text: I visited after hearing that they had moved and it was delicious. The broth is very thick and delicious. Boiled pork? I ordered that too, but it came out cold and thin, with a slightly flaky texture. It wasn't bad, but I think I could just eat ramen. I ate well

reviews.author: Sung Won Chang
reviews.text:
I had Chashu Misomen.
The chashu was thin and the noodles were thin and slightly chewy. The menu wasn't my favorite, but the reviews were good, so I'm planning to visit to try other menu items.

reviews.author: DioBrand
reviews.text:
2025.10.28 First visit.

Ordered Tonkotsu Chashumen.

The noodles and soup didn't have any impact, but they weren't bad. I was satisfied with the generous amount of chashu that lived up to the name Chashu Men. However, the wood ear mushrooms and added ajitsuke tamago were not my taste. I tend to like all ramen toppings to be kept at a similar temperature, but both toppings were a bit cold, which slightly broke my immersion.

The store was the hardest to find out of all the places I've been to recently. Hidden in the alley. The fact that it was located in such an alley, the entrance, and the interior made me feel like I was in Japan.

I don't know if I'll come again.

reviews.author: BONG
reviews.text:
A ramen restaurant located in an alley one block down the commercial district of Ewha Womans University.

The moment I entered the store, there was a thick smell of oil or something, and it wasn't very crowded even during meal times.

The spicy menu is quite spicy and has a stinging sensation that goes beyond the sharpness of capsaicin. The regular menu has a small amount compared to the price and has a lack of content.
It is true that wood ear mushrooms and other small vegetables served as highlights, but they did not seem enough to enhance the flavor of the ramen or make it special.

The price is a little more expensive than the typical price of commonly eaten ramen.

The seasoned chives that came with it were quite delicious.

No intention of returning. There are some recommended doctors.

reviews.author: kazel
reviews.text:
Previously, Gayagaya Ramen Restaurant near the University of Foreign Studies was my favorite restaurant. This is my first time coming to Ewha Womans University branch, which is the main branch.

Perhaps because we came a little after lunch time, the inside of the store was very quiet. It's been a while since I wanted to try something spicy, so I ordered Karai Tonkotsu Ramen. It had a mild spicy taste and was worth eating.
The soup is really just my style. The ramen noodles were a bit chewy, but I wish they were a little softer for my style. It's a place where you can have a reasonably delicious meal.
I was a little disappointed that the char siu meat included only one very thin piece of meat, but it was soft and edible.

reviews.author: Lee Kyung-ha
reviews.text:
Rice and soup curry are served separately.
The store is small, so waiting on weekends is a must.
The spiciness can be adjusted and additional toppings are also available.
It's great to have a warm bowl in chilly weather. it is delicious.!

reviews.author: Suha Choi
reviews.text:
Hongdae Courageal is soup curry🥘
The flavor is crazy with the addition of mala flavor🌶️
I’m full because there are unlimited rice refills🍚
Definitely recommended if you like spices
The spiciness can be adjusted so give it a try🔥
It’s a delicious restaurant with a local feel✨

reviews.author: yahanaya
reviews.text:
I thought I had eaten a lot of Japanese food.
Try eating here, okay?!!! What is it? Jeonnam is delicious hahaha
There is a solo bar so it's good for eating alone.
I think 2-4 people could come :)
There are hair ties all over the table, which is a nice touch! Good
Eating grilled vegetables tastes good 👍🏼

reviews.author: Cha Min-chang
reviews.text:
I came here because I enjoyed the suage, but
It just tastes close to curry, and it's a bit hard to call it a soup curry.
I'm curry! The taste I want.

A bit salty and not spicy. The toppings are definitely better with vegetables than suage, but the chashu is also better than suage.

Overall, I was disappointed compared to my expectations. The taste isn't bad, but I wouldn't visit again.

reviews.author: Dohyung Kim
reviews.text:
This is a soup curry restaurant located near Hapjeong Station. There are two tables for 4 people and the rest only have bar seating.

The soup curry was flavorful, but it was difficult to find what was special about it. The taste of the char siu was covered by the curry, so I couldn't taste the original taste of the char siu.

Everyone who went with me said it was delicious, so this may be a subjective opinion.

reviews.author: CampingshowCamping show
reviews.text: The squid sashimi is fresh and plentiful. I was very satisfied with Skidashi because it was diverse and well-constructed, just as I had heard about it. First, before the raw squid, seasoned raw fish, and my favorite sardines, braised radish, fish cuttlefish, and pupae. Seaweed stems, savory corn salad, and shrimp crackers that looked like they were fried themselves were served. I liked that I was able to taste a variety of side dishes that were not obvious. The hall space is large and the tables are divided into several spaces, making it convenient for company dinners or gatherings.

reviews.author: Dr. Cho
reviews.text:
They say this place has delicious cuttlefish sashimi...
The bones in the sashimi were chewy, probably because it wasn't prepared well...
The scallops served as a side dish were not in good condition...

reviews.author: Joojoo Min (Joojoo)
reviews.text: If you want to eat raw shrimp, definitely come here.

reviews.author: Jaeyoung Kim
reviews.text: A cheap and plentiful raw fish restaurant near Hapjeong Station! All of the raw fish is fresh and the sashimi is plentiful. The owner is friendly and has been handling cuttlefish for quite some time, so if you want to eat cuttlefish sashimi, it will be available until June!

reviews.author: WOORI CHO
reviews.text:
Fresh and delicious seafood
It is said that raw fish will be sold after measuring its radioactivity.
Clean restrooms, friendly staff, delicious food
The age range of guests is wide.

reviews.author: JS Park
reviews.text:
Mazesoba is the main focus here.
There are many variations based on maze soba, and there is also shoyu ramen.
Unlike Japan, Mazesoba is not salty, but it seems to have been arranged to suit Korean tastes.
It was easy to eat and tasted good.
However, the downside is that the price is a bit expensive compared to the quantity.

reviews.author: Michael Han
reviews.text:
Mazesoba Shrine
This is Menya Hanabi.

Visit all Hapjeong, Jamsil, and Shinto shrines
This is a restaurant that always comes to mind when the time comes.

Minjjie seasoning evenly absorbed into the noodles.
Mazesoba lacks nothing, even the thick noodles.

I mixed the rice and ate it.
Boring shaving.
Delicious kelp vinegar

This is a restaurant where everything is in perfect harmony.

reviews.author: food_dairy bang
reviews.text: Although it is the origin of Mazesoba and started in Songnidan-gil, there is little difference in taste even in distant branches, and it is a famous Mazesoba restaurant that offers a feast of bouncy, savory, and diverse flavors.  As expected, kelp vinegar was a really good ingredient to enhance the taste.

reviews.author: wooden flute
reviews.text:
I ate here on the first day of official opening.
The main branch in Jamsil is far away, so I was always looking forward to it... but it opened in Hapjeong!
It was delicious!
The location is not bad for accessibility, so I think I'll stop by often.

reviews.author: mi mi
reviews.text:
A unique maze soba restaurant~
There are about two tables and a long bar table, so you can sit at the bar table and eat.
It's nice to be able to charge underneath each seat^^
The taste is one that has strong likes and dislikes... Personally, the seasoning was strong and a bit salty. If you like strong flavors, this is the place for you^^
I think the seasoning is right when you mix the rice together.^^

reviews.author: Jiyoung Choi
reviews.text:
Since my first visit to Hyeonudong, I go here every summer to eat their Bukkake cold udon. I have already been there four times this year.
I always think about trying different menu items, but I end up ordering Tempura Bukage Cold Udon. The fried food (mushrooms, sweet pumpkin, shrimp, eggplant, and red pepper flakes) is perfect, and most of all, the noodles are really delicious. Tsuyu is sweet.
The hostess who always greets me warmly every time I go is so beautiful and friendly, which makes me happy! Thank you always.

reviews.author: Kim Dong-yoon
reviews.text:
26.01.01. Hyeonwoo-dong located in Hongdae. Although Gangnam is the main branch, we visited the Hongdae branch, which was geographically closer. I visited in the evening, and unexpectedly there were no customers and it was quiet.

I had one cold udon and one hot udon, and it was so delicious that it couldn't be compared to nearby Udon Kaden or Kyo Daiya. I especially recommend the cold udon.

reviews.author: Park Sang-wook
reviews.text:
I heard that there was a Japanese udon restaurant near Hongdae that was listed in the Michelin Guide for 5 consecutive years, so I visited it.
As rumored, the texture of the noodles was comparable to that of local udon restaurants in Japan, and the visuals of the food were so pretty that it was a shame not to touch them.
The chicken karaage and pork cutlet I ordered on the side were just as good as those from a specialty restaurant.
The store was well managed and the kitchen was very clean, so I was able to eat comfortably.

reviews.author: Iphi Lee
reviews.text:
I think that in a udon restaurant, the noodles themselves are overwhelmingly important. In that respect, it is very excellent. It was chewy and very delicious. I was debating between toriten and karaage as a side dish, so I ordered toriten, and the fries were very good. I'm curious about other menus as well.
The framed open kitchen also increases trust. (It was neat)

reviews.author: Alex Han
reviews.text: The taste is okay. However, the taste is more ordinary than I expected, perhaps because I had high expectations since it is a restaurant that is consistently included in the Michelin Guide. I already had bukkake udon for lunch, so I ordered curry udon, but next time I'll try bukkake udon.

reviews.author: Flipply
reviews.text: I said I like Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, and my friend recommended that I go to Hoyodo! Because it is Hiroshima-style, it has a light yet rich taste. In addition to okonomiyaki, there are a variety of Japanese menu items, including gyukatsu, Japanese steak, tonpeiyaki, and yakisoba. The menu is good as a meal or as a snack, so it's perfect for a meal or a drink. If you like Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, go!

reviews.author: Y L
reviews.text: I went to Hongdae to find a delicious izakaya. I couldn't drink alcohol, so I had an ade, but the Hiroshima okonomiyaki was so delicious. The gyukatsu was plentiful and had good meat quality! The staff are friendly and the atmosphere is nice.

reviews.author: Sooyeon Choi (Chumtony)
reviews.text: The okonomiyaki here is really delicious, and since they have a teppan, all the teppan dishes are really good! The atmosphere is good too! It was such a deliciously happy time! The staff were friendly and the open kitchen seemed to be run cleanly and well, so I enjoyed my meal! Haha, there are many types of highballs and Japanese sake, so even people who like alcohol will like it! I intend to visit again. I will go again next time to try the delicious food!!

reviews.author: Fran
reviews.text:
Wow~ There was an izakaya specializing in hot teppan dishes on the hot streets of Hongdae!

The staff are very friendly with a lively atmosphere😊

I had okonomiyaki and yakisoba as a cost-effective set menu, and it was full of vegetables, seafood, and meat.
The portion size was so large that I was able to completely fill my stomach🥬🦑🥓

It goes great with a neat highball!

If you sit at the bar table, you can see cooking on a teppan being done😍👍 Sometimes you can even see fire shows~🔥

reviews.author: proto russian
reviews.text: I think the biggest advantage is that you can taste both Hiroshima-style and Kyoto-style okonomiyaki. If you want to have a delicious meal in a special atmosphere with friends or lovers, I highly recommend Hoyo Hongdae branch. I definitely want to try other panyaki menu items the next time I visit!

reviews.author: RJ Oh
reviews.text:
I think this is the best curry restaurant in Seoul!!
The portions of curry, toppings, and rice are all generous, and most of all, the atmosphere inside is unique and fun.
It's a place I really like because it's not only fun to eat, but also fun to look at the props!
I hope you prosper for a long time🍛

reviews.author: yeon
reviews.text: I had tomato curry and it was delicious! It's not an ordinary curry flavor, but it's delicious. However, it was a shame that I couldn't eat comfortably because the store was small (capacity for about 10 people) and I felt like I had to eat quickly and leave.😢

reviews.author: Hyunji Shin
reviews.text:
A place where a cute Japanese owner welcomes you and a friendly Korean owner greets you!
The interior is really cute, Japanese-like, dark but cozy. It's a good place to come alone or with a friend and have a meal while talking quietly.
I know there used to be toppings like sausage or bacon enoki mushroom rolls, but now I think there's only fried eggs. However, the taste of the curry itself was warm and hearty, like soul food, so I enjoyed it. For reference, it was a slightly spicy curry.

reviews.author: Haim Jung
reviews.text: A curry restaurant run by two Japanese husband and wife owners. Because the store is very small and all bar seating is available, it is recommended that only one or two people visit. Mozzarella cheese topping was added to moyashi curry. There are filling options on the menu, but the basic portion was sufficient. Moyashi curry contains rice as the base, along with curry, a fried egg, potatoes, minced meat, and stir-fried bean sprouts. They say it's spicy, but as a Korean, I didn't notice it too much, and I could feel that each topping was cooked with care. Since there are more toppings than rice, it is recommended to eat a little rice with a lot of toppings.

reviews.author: talking potato
reviews.text: As soon as I entered, I felt like I was in Japan with Japanese songs and various cute props. I ordered cheese curry, soda, and latte. The drinks were delicious and the curry was satisfying! The owner was friendly and it was a good curry restaurant that was fun to look at and eat.🥰

address: 1st floor, 375-1, Seogyo-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Yumin Kim
reviews.text:
It's good value for money and the atmosphere is like Japan, so it's fun haha.
The food is delicious too!
I don’t think I need to eat the salad again, but I will definitely go back to eat the aji fries again. It’s so delicious!
However, the store is small, so if you don't have time, you may have to wait, which is a real drawback.

reviews.author: Mari PARK
reviews.text:
Every single piece of food is delicious.
Except for the waiting...it's good.
Sometimes when I go there, there's a new menu and it's fun to order it.
I highly recommend sashimi moriase, aji fry, ankimo stew, futomaki green onion udon, sweet potato, and burdock fry.
The cilantro highball and tomato salad are delicious.

reviews.author: Mari Park
reviews.text:
A cost-effective aged sashimi izakaya!
The taste level is different from izakayas that only reheat frozen products.
All the food is delicious and reasonably priced.
I think the price range is due to the characteristics of the Hongdae area.. Cilantro Highball Tomato Sawa is good!!!

reviews.author: Moong Lee
reviews.text:
Visited after recommendation from a friend! The small and cute atmosphere wasn't bad (although it was cramped)...

For food, I tried Gobong Obong Sushi, but it was late and sold out... But all the other menu items were so delicious and the quality was really good! I really recommend the sashimi, and the nabe is a bit salty, but it's okay as a side dish.

Yuzu highball recommended!

reviews.author: rere
reviews.text:
I went there around 6pm on a Saturday two weeks ago, and I was confused because there were no people in front of me and the waiting list was very long. First, while I was sitting in front of the store and waiting, an employee wearing a mask called out the names of the people who had written down the waiting list in a low voice 'just once', and when there was no response, he deleted them. In that way, approximately 10 people were eliminated.
Huh? I wanted to do that, but I originally thought it was a good thing that I waited in front of Hana, but suddenly the people whose names were cleared came from somewhere else, so the people who had been waiting in front and who were just about to go in were not allowed in, and they let the person whose name was cleared go in first??? Of course, the people who tried to enter were annoyed... It was very chaotic haha.

I waited for about an hour to get in, and it was a bit noisy so I wasn't in a good mood, but it calmed down after I ate some snacks.
Even though I was irritated, it seemed to subside...
All three snacks were delicious.
The cilantro highball was a bit disappointing because all the cilantro seemed to be very spoiled.

I would recommend it to my friends, but unless you are planning to go for an open run on a weekday, I think I would tell you not to wait.
I would like to go again if the waiting system is changed neatly.

address: 1st floor, 148 Donggyo-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: move
reviews.text: The service and atmosphere are average, but the sushi quality seems to be 1 point. The fact that one piece of sushi was cut in the middle was also bad when I saw it. The taste of the sushi was average.

reviews.author: 92 Tam
reviews.text:
I didn't eat it and just left, so my taste evaluation was neutral.
The service mindset is so badㅡㅡㅋ
